versions.subject: Merge PR #4831 from @swachchhanda000 - Add Kapeka backdoor related Sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_generic:
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - ':\ProgramData\'
        - '\AppData\Local\'
    TargetFilename|re: '\\[a-zA-Z]{5,6}\.wll'
selection_specific:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '\win32log.exe'
        - '\crdss.exe'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: | rex field=TargetFilename "(?<TargetFilenameMatch>\\\\[a-zA-Z]{5,6}\\.wll)" | eval TargetFilenameCondition=if(isnotnull(TargetFilenameMatch), "true", "false") | search (TargetFilename IN ("*:\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\*") TargetFilenameCondition="true") OR TargetFilename IN ("*\\win32log.exe", "*\\crdss.exe")
